picks.title: Ocean Swift Intros Dev Ocean Modular Synthesis & Sound Design Environment
picks.excerpt: Ocean Swift released DevOcean Modular, a 145-module software modular synthesis and sound-design environment. Its standout feature is MaYa, a built-in modular AI agent that patches alongside the user, suggesting and wiring modules during the creative process. It is an early example of a generative AI 'co-patcher' embedded directly inside a modular synth workflow rather than a text-to-song generator. Available now for EUR 129.99 (35% off EUR 199 MSRP until September 1, 2026).
picks.rationale: A generative AI 'co-patcher' living inside a modular synth — a creation-tool shift that changes how sound designers build patches, not just another text-to-song generator; no prior music card covers it.

picks.title: 90,000 AI tracks flood Deezer daily - passing 50% of all new music uploads for the first time
picks.excerpt: Deezer revealed that fully AI-generated music topped 50% of daily uploads for the first time in June 2026, with roughly 90,000 AI tracks arriving each day - up from 75,000 in April. The platform says up to 85% of streams from such tracks were fraudulent, and it is removing AI content used for stream manipulation as well as tracks with no plays in six months. A concrete data point on how generative AI is reshaping what lands on streaming and how listeners encounter it.
picks.rationale: First-ever 50% milestone with hard June numbers (90k/day, 85% fraudulent streams) — the environment every releasing artist now competes in; a distinct full report only glancingly referenced in the earlier AI-earnings card.

picks.title: Fender Studio Pro 8.1 review: AI stem separation, generation and a Studio Assistant land in Fender's DAW
picks.excerpt: MusicTech reviews Fender's free Studio Pro 8.1 DAW, which now leans heavily on AI: a Moises-powered engine handles both stem separation and stem generation, alongside voice replacement and AI vocal pitch-correction. A new beta 'Studio Assistant' chatbot (Pro+ tier) answers production questions inside the app. It marks a mainstream, no-cost DAW folding Moises-grade AI directly into the mixing/mastering workflow rather than as an add-on.
picks.rationale: A free, mainstream DAW folding Moises-grade AI (stem separation + generation, voice replacement, a Studio Assistant chatbot) straight into the production workflow — changes what a bedroom producer can do tomorrow at zero cost; net-new creation-side item.

picks.title: iZotope VEA - one-knob AI vocal enhancement built from RX and Nectar tech - is free until July 31
picks.excerpt: iZotope is giving away VEA (normally $29), a stripped-down vocal-enhancement plugin that repackages the AI-assisted processing from its RX, Ozone and Nectar suites into three controls - Clean, Shape and Boost - for de-noising, tone-shaping and presence. Aimed at podcasters, streamers and producers who want RX-grade cleanup without the deep interface, it lowers the barrier to iZotope's machine-learning audio tools. The free window runs through July 31, 2026, tied to Boris FX's acquisition of iZotope.
picks.rationale: RX/Nectar-grade AI vocal cleanup distilled into three knobs and free through July 31 — an accessibility shift that puts machine-learning audio repair in reach of any creator; net-new and time-sensitive.
